description: Blank lines after the last item in a file are ignored
notes: The Body production is (Attribute | Block | OneLineBlock)*, which has no place for a newline that doesn't end an item, and the prose only says newlines are ignored "in certain contexts" without naming bodies. hashicorp/hcl skips newline tokens wherever a body item may start: before the first item, between items, after the last one and in a body with no items (parser.ParseBody in hclsyntax/parser.go).
